actionTypes.description: Only return segments whose action matches one of these. Leave empty to include every action.
actionTypes.title: Action types

categories.description: Only return these SponsorBlock categories. Leave empty to include every category.
categories.title: Segment categories

concurrency.description: How many videos to process at the same time. Higher is faster but can trigger rate limits.
concurrency.title: Simultaneous videos

includeDescriptions.description: Include the community-written note attached to a segment when one exists.
includeDescriptions.title: Include segment descriptions

includeHiddenSegments.description: When the source is 'All submissions', also return segments hidden by moderation or a shadowbanned submitter.
includeHiddenSegments.title: Include hidden submissions

includeSubmitterInfo.description: Resolve each segment's public SponsorBlock submitter ID to a username and aggregate stats when available. Never exposes private IDs.
includeSubmitterInfo.title: Include public submitter info

includeSummary.description: Add one per-video summary row (segment count, total seconds, category/action breakdown) and one run summary row.
includeSummary.title: Include summary rows

includeYouTubeMetadata.description: Add the video title, channel name/URL/ID, thumbnail, YouTube duration, view count, publish date, and live status from YouTube's public oEmbed and player endpoints.
includeYouTubeMetadata.title: Include YouTube metadata

maxSegmentsPerVideo.description: Keep at most this many segments per video after filtering and sorting by start time. Use 0 for no limit.
maxSegmentsPerVideo.title: Maximum segments per video

minVotes.description: Drop segments with fewer community votes than this. Use -2 to include every submission, 0 to drop downvoted ones, or a higher value to keep only well-confirmed segments.
minVotes.title: Minimum votes

source.description: Use 'Visible segments' for the segments SponsorBlock currently acts on. Use 'All submissions' to include hidden and disputed submissions from the search database.
source.title: Segment source

videoUrls.description: YouTube video URLs or 11-character video IDs. Accepts watch, youtu.be, Shorts, live, embed, and music links. Add multiple videos for a batch.
videoUrls.title: Video URLs or IDs
